rules.text: Returns or exchanges are not accepted after one year from purchase or receipt.
rules.quote: Please note: After one year, we will no longer accept returns or exchanges.

rules.text: Online orders must be returned within 30 days of delivery to receive a refund to the original form of payment.
rules.quote: If we receive your return at our warehouse within 30 days of delivery, we’ll credit your original form of payment.

rules.text: Returns received after 30 days of delivery will be issued a Free People e-gift card.
rules.quote: If it's received after 30 days, a Free People e-gift card will be issued.

rules.text: Opened and used Beauty and Wellness products cannot be returned.
rules.quote: We’re unable to process returns for opened and used Beauty and Wellness products.

rules.text: Swimwear or intimate apparel that has been worn or is soiled cannot be returned.
rules.quote: We’re unable to process returns for swimwear or intimate apparel items that have been worn or are returned in a soiled condition.

rules.text: FP MART and Vintage items cannot be returned or exchanged to Free People stores or warehouse; returns are at seller's discretion.
rules.quote: FP MART and Vintage styles cannot be returned or exchanged to Free People stores or to Free People's warehouse. Returns are at the discretion of the seller.

rules.text: Nuuly Resale items sold through FreePeople.com are final sale and cannot be returned online or in store.
rules.quote: Nuuly Resale items sold through FreePeople.com are final sale and cannot be returned online or in store.

rules.text: Returns must be accompanied by the original store sales receipt and attached Free People price tickets.
rules.quote: Items must include the attached Free People price tickets and be accompanied by the original store sales receipt.

rules.text: Refunds within 30 days of delivery are credited to the original form of payment; after 30 days, refunds are issued as Free People e-gift cards.
rules.quote: If we receive your return at our warehouse within 30 days of delivery, we’ll credit your original form of payment. If it's received after 30 days, a Free People e-gift card will be issued.

rules.text: Gift returns are refunded as e-gift cards sent to the email address provided.
rules.quote: Once the return is received, an e-gift card will be issued.
rules.reviewNote: The summary adds that the e-gift card is sent to the email address provided, which is not stated in the quote.

rules.text: Store purchases with a gift receipt can be exchanged or refunded in store for the value on the gift receipt.
rules.quote: For store purchases, returns with a gift receipt can be exchanged or refunded in store for the value indicated on the gift receipt and refunds will be made in the form of a merchandise credit.
rules.reviewNote: The summary omits that refunds will be made in the form of a merchandise credit, which is specified in the quote.

rules.text: Customers are responsible for return shipping costs on furniture and oversized items.
rules.quote: Customers are responsible for any return shipping costs.
rules.reviewNote: The summary specifies 'furniture and oversized items,' but the quote applies to any return shipping costs, not just those categories.
